notes.title: 1.5 Anarchy Patch
notes.content:
With this patch, we want to say goodbye to the Beat Slayer year 2024 with a bang. In addition to a new upgrade type, we also have something new for the Beat Slayer veterans among you.

[h2]New Upgrade Type: "Tanzschock Upgrade"[/h2]

Unleash rhythmic destruction with the all-new Tanzschock Upgrade! Trigger its powerful effects every time you reach 10 Beats on your Beat Meter and at every 20 Beat interval thereafter (10, 30, 50, 70...). Choose from the following versions:
[list]

[*] Tanzschock Taser
Effect: Stuns all enemies for one tact.

[*] Tanzschock Laser
Effect: Activates four laser beams for one tact.

[*] Tanzschock Barrage
Effect: Fires a barrage of projectiles around you.

[*] Tanzschock Repulsor
Effect: Knocks back all enemies around you.

[*] Tanzschock Explosion
 Effect: Deals damage in a large area around you.
[/list]

[h2]New Game Mode: Anarchy[/h2]

In the previous difficulty levels, you may have noticed that some enemies only appear in later acts. In Anarchy mode, we are throwing this rule overboard. The enemies are much stronger and Elite versions can now appear anywhere and at any time. In addition, some rhythm aids are deactivated, which makes every beat combo a real challenge.

Now it's the best time to check out Beat Slayer. Let us know what you think and write us here on Steam, [url=https://discord.gg/pSn4J8XzXT]Discord [/url]or [url=https://x.com/ByteRockers]Twitter/X[/url]!

Until then, stay tuned!

notes.title: 1.4 Hazard Patch Notes - Beat Slayer
notes.content:
The Steam Rythm Festival is coming round the corner and what better way to celebrate than with a big patch for Beat Slayer :D In this patch we have prepared a few things for you to make Mia's journey through Berlin even more varied and to provide more "destruction".
 
[h2]New Hazard: Laser Walls[/h2]
Some Levels in Act 3 now have Laser Barriers that turn on and off to the beat.
Getting caught in the beam will hurt you, but enemies take even more damage from it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806889/7fcc352f9a5f11c130f1a5dcbb3ffa4d6bf81b16.png[/img]
 
 
[h2]Destructibles[/h2]
You can find destructible objects (like Crates and Vases) in most levels. 
Destroying them has a chance of granting you some Currywurst and other Powerups! 
Be Careful - many levels also have explosive barrels that, when destroyed, do massive damage to anything nearby!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806889/1571185c5f9b09a33e38275361fe464df900c4b5.png[/img]
 
 
[h2]Enemy Spawner Improvements[/h2]
We tweaked the enemy spawning system, allowing enemies to use the whole level to determine where to spawn.
Enemy spawns are now less "clustered" and will often lead to situations where the player is in danger of being surrounded.
This also increases the enemy density in some levels in Acts 2 and 3.  
 
 
[h2]Hammer Improvements[/h2]
The Hammer's Basic Attack area of effect has been increased. 
It's now easier to hit enemies, especially when they're close to you.
 
 

[h2]Donna Balancing[/h2]
Donna had already adjusted her training a little in the last patch. In the interests of fairness, however, we would like to inform you about this as well.

To provide a more well-rounded power progression, we added additional levels for some of Donna's Upgrades:
Combat Style: +3 additional Levels
Tanzrausch Effect: +3 additional Levels
Energy Gain upgrades: +3 additional Levels
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806889/f238fc28bdc8b2671ddd75bc8274595049627714.jpg[/img]

Now it's the best time to check out Beat Slayer. Let us know what you think and write us here on Steam, [url=https://discord.gg/pSn4J8XzXT]Discord [/url]or [url=https://x.com/ByteRockers]Twitter/X[/url]!

Until then, stay tuned!

Hey everyone! 
 
We hope you’ve all been enjoying your Time with Beat Slayer so far! We have some exciting news for future updates for you today. 
 
Take a look at our Roadmap for 2024 below:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806889/86dba099b958ac23897616523dd5a68d17f6aa48.jpg[/img]
 
We’ve got 3 main patches coming over the remainder of the year, with the first going live one week from now! This is what you can expect:

Hopefully you’re as pumped for these updates as we are! Until then, we look forward to hearing your thoughts and feedback here on Steam, our [url=https://discord.gg/V9JSNw7mDP]Discord[/url], or [url=https://x.com/ByteRockers]Twitter[/url]!

notes.title: 1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey guys, 

Thank you for playing Beat Slayer. We appreciate every message from you here or on Discord and try to consider your wishes and suggestions. But first and foremost we want to fix the bugs that happened to you :D That's why patch 1.2 is all about bugfixing and polishing.

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Mia did not get an upgrade after a canceled utility upgrade.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash after defeating the second boss.
[*] Fixed missing ground in some levels.
[*] Fixed a bug that did not increase the probability of upgrade families after Donna upgrade.
[*] Fixed Narrative bugs
[*] Fixed a bug where some Steam achievements were not unlocked.
[*] Fixed a bug where the shield bot was not distributing shields.
[*] Quality settings on the Steam Deck are now available.
[/list]
 
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Robot spawn rate has been revised
[*] Total life of the second boss has been slightly reduced
[/list]
 
[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] Various small audio, dialogue and visual improvements
[/list]

Otherwise, we look forward to hearing from you here on Steam. Or follow us on [url=https://www.instagram.com/byterockers.games/?hl=en]Instagram[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/ByteRockers]Twitter[/url].

notes.title: Beat Slayer is out NOW!
notes.content:
Our game Beat Slayer is finally out! 🎉
 
Almost 3 years have passed since we developed the first prototype of Beat Slayer.
We showcased the game at over 20 conventions, exhibitions and fairs all over the globe.
We got covered by several gaming news sites and streamers such as IGN and HandofBlood .
 
Despite hurdles such as the stealth release of "Hi-Fi Rush", we kept on going and turned that hurdle into a guidepost to a game that's different and unique.
 
Beat Slayer is not only the first rhythm-based hack n' slay roguelite, but also our most ambitious project to date!
 
We still can't believe that this moment has finally come.
Thanks to everyone who helped us along this way!
 
We're very proud to announce that you can get your very own copy of Beat Slayer on Steam now

notes.title: If HiFi Rush and Fallout had a baby, it'd be this Steam roguelike
notes.content:
If there's one thing I am a little too obsessed with, it's rhythm games. One of my favorite PC games ever made is Metal Hellsinger, and before that I spent far too much time on Riot Forge's Hextech Mayhem. This Steam Next Fest, though, my attention has turned to Beat Slayer, a new indie that channels the gritty, gloomy dystopian setting of Fallout and the on-beat combat and comic book style of HiFi Rush. If two of the best Bethesda games had a baby, it'd be this game.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Pre Alpha-Demo out now!
notes.content:
Some of you may have already noticed that we have quite a lot going on with Beat Slayer. From Gamescom Asia in Singapore to GDC, Nordic Game and Gamescom in Cologne, we've been on a world tour with Beat Slayer. In this post, we'd like to give you a little update on the current state of the game and the future of Mia's adventure.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806889/c10eef3c1b993fd3481d2b692ee5b58c7bf3de89.png[/img]

First things first: We are still working hard on Beat Slayer and are looking forward to introducing you to new levels and enemies, as well as one or two new weapons 😉. Here's a [b]sneak peek[/b] at some of the levels from the first act. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806889/0adb4e768af19746a17f7b99b0bd1da2e8dd398f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806889/b821ef7c51edea3c4fd4642542ae7274ef1c452d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806889/c2cfc6bd93c26c7c54ace3eb5855c5cfcce3a9bf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806889/5786a2431fbe07ec3075ae004597dfb4f39d2707.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806889/2c67cebabe9aa0f85b15a9057b9276a466bff5f1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806889/496ca12f403e9a0fe73d163513ac8b8c49386adf.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806889/bcf822a7c9433cdc8b58f23f21adfcf36cd084a2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806889/d6e4a0e5e4ffc82b73768786ae979a150465c021.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806889/022b067fa8766ee297ef45594b294cadc8ad1efa.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806889/8e2d3e9b85df402ee8348bcca7e7b8089ac706fb.png[/img][/url]

In order to be able to offer you a comprehensive and above all breathtaking demo, [b]we have decided to wait until Steam Next in February 2024[/b]. However, in order to not leave you completely empty-handed, [b]we are releasing a demo here on Steam today[/b], which we have already presented at numerous trade shows and events, and which has made many visitors get to know and love Beat Slayer. This is still a pre-alpha version, which should give you a small insight into the world of Beat Slayer and already lets you [b]turn the first robots into scrap metal[/b]. 

[previewyoutube=ygwdPb-oxqQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Visitors of the Gamescom fair in Cologne this year will already know the demo :D. Otherwise we are very happy if you try the demo. If you have feedback or encounter bugs, you can join the specially created [url=https://discord.gg/8q7KC4xXSh]Discord[/url] where you can get in touch with us developers. Otherwise, feel free to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ByteRockers]Twitter(X)[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/byterockers.games/]Instagram[/url], where we regularly post new updates about Beat Slayer. Or check out the community tab on Steam here. There's even a [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@beatslayergame]TikTok account[/url] that we're trying out right now. Feel free to check it out there.

Thanks for playing our first demo here on Steam, and maybe we'll see you in Discord soon.

[b]Stay tuned![/b]

ByteRockers‘ Games

notes.title: Beat Slayer @ GDC23
notes.content:
Last week we've attended the Game Developer Conference in San Francisco.
It was an amazing and astonishing experience, not only because it was our first time there, 
but also because we let players play a very early demo of Beat Slayer for the first time ever. 

Getting our first direct feedback for the game and meeting new people made this event more than worthwhile.
We gave out brochure with informations about all our games. We spend 8 hours a day talking to all kinds of trade visitors and took lots and lots of pictures of people holding our stunning flamethrower axe replica.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806889/7b42f76a584d266bf3ab60241bd4a0b61fa383d2.jpg[/img]

Every single ByteRocker, who's been there gave 100% and it shows. 
Hearing "this is definitely the best game here" motivates us even more to deliver the most awesome game we could possibly develop!
Thanks a lot for everyone who visited us at our booth and also to everyone who wishlisted Beat Slayer! 

If you're interested you can wishlist the game, here: 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2089830/Beat_Slayer/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806889/266993e9a0ca27f526260424c83aaa29f09bab3a.png[/img]

Thanks for reading and see you next time!

notes.title: Creating your own symphony of destruction @GDC2023
notes.content:
"We are thrilled to announce our new game: Beat Slayer, a rhythmic roguelike hack n’ slay game.

[previewyoutube=EiQNLti2Ios;full][/previewyoutube]

We will be attending the Game Developers Conference 2023 in San Francisco to showcase our progress and get your feedback. 
Beat Slayer is a game that combines rhythm and fighting in a unique way. You have to match your moves to the beat of the soundtrack, while using crazy weapons like the flamethrowing axe to destroy hordes of robots. The game is set in a dystopian 80s inspired Berlin, where you play as Mia, a badass music lover and crafty tinkerer. 
We are excited to let you try our demo at our booth. 
You will be able to experience some of the locations, challenges and tunes that we have created so far for Beat Slayer. You will also be able to see one of the weapons that we are planning to add in the future.
